page_title: REN 1-2 NIC | Rennes v Nice 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Rennes due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+5' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Rennes players aren’t happy.
90+4' Goal! Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) finds the back of the net with a good effort.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) inside the box.
89' The game is interrupted now, Antoine Mendy (Nice) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
87' The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.

87' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) skips past a few defenders in the penalty area and strikes a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his effort with a superb save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Rennes are going to take it.
85' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Yehvann Diouf.
84' Brice Samba (Rennes) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Marc Bollengier didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
83' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Yehvann Diouf (Nice).
80' Habib Beye (Rennes) picks up a yellow card for unsporting behaviour after the half-time whistle. He should have gone straight into the dressing room instead.
80' Handball! A player from Rennes handled the ball. Nice are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
78' Breel Embolo (Rennes) was probably a bit loose with his words to Marc Bollengier, who decides to show him a yellow.
78' A yellow card for a tackle by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes). Marc Bollengier doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
77' Substitution. Sofiane Diop walks off the pitch and Morgan Sanson (Nice) comes on as a substitute.
77' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Tiago Gouveia (Nice) replaces Salis Abdul Samed.

76' Excellent touch by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.

74' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Yehvann Diouf pulls off a decent save to thwart him.
72' Substitution. Juma Bah (Nice) on for Ali Abdi.
71' Rennes take a short corner kick.
69' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) sees a yellow card from Marc Bollengier after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
67' 1 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 1:2.
67' Tom Louchet (Nice) picks up a yellow card.
65' Djaoui Cisse (Rennes) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
63' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
62' Bernard Nguene (Nice) brings his opponent down. Marc Bollengier has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Rennes have a free kick.
62' Habib Beye prepares a substitution. Quentin Merlin is replaced by Mohamed Meite (Rennes).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Bernard Nguene (Nice) coming on for Kevin.

60' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is badly mistimed and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
58' Habib Beye decides to make a substitution. Mahdi Camara will be replaced by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes).
58' We are about to witness a substitution. Abdelhamid Ait Boudlal (Rennes) is replacing Seko Fofana.
57' Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.
57' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
55' Breel Embolo (Rennes) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Nice.
51' Kevin (Nice) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' Sofiane Diop (Nice) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
46' Half-time substitution. Jonathan Clauss will not participate anymore and Tom Louchet (Nice) is coming on.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Esteban Lepaul comes off for Mousa Tamari (Rennes).
46' Half-time substitution. Habib Beye decided to make a change. Alidu Seidu is replaced by Przemyslaw Frankowski (Rennes).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' Marc Bollengier has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+6' Jeremy Jacquet (Rennes) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
45+4' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Nice players have a reason to celebrate!
45+3' The Nice players halt their celebrations as referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
45+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Jonathan Clauss (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:2.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
43' The resulting corner, taken by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), comes to nothing.
40' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

38' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonathan Clauss puts Sofiane Diop (Nice) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the left side of the goal. 0:1.
36' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
33' A corner kick by Rennes is thwarted by the well prepared Yehvann Diouf (Nice).

33' Seko Fofana (Rennes) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner.
31' Marc Bollengier shows a yellow card to Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) for a tough tackle.
29' Marc Bollengier shows the yellow card to Mahdi Camara (Rennes) for a heavy challenge.

28' That didn't go as planned! Valentin Rongier (Rennes) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Yehvann Diouf, who easily kept it out.
27' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
25' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Jeremie Boga (Nice) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
19' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Nice.
17' The percentage of ball possession is – 51:49.
13' Nice fail to score from a corner as Brice Samba (Rennes) leaps to collect the ball.
12' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Nice win a corner.
9' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
9' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

9' Nice have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag. Salis Abdul Samed (Nice) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
8' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

5' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
4' A quickly taken corner by Rennes.
3' Rennes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
3' A cross into the box from Breel Embolo (Rennes) is cleared. Rennes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Rennes will have the kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will officiate today.
